featured.title: LifeOS
featured.subtitle: Personal Life Management System
featured.description: A full-stack productivity platform combining task management, structured note-taking, and a context-aware AI assistant in a single unified workspace.
highlights: AI Action System — assistant creates/updates/deletes tasks & notes directly in MongoDB
AI provider waterfall: Gemini → Grok → Ollama for zero-crash fail-safe responses
JWT authentication, drag-and-drop ordering, recurrence engine & full UI customization
Layered architecture: routes → core → MongoDB with config-driven schema factory

featured.title: OmniTranslate Agent
featured.subtitle: AI-Powered Document Translator
featured.description: A two-phase AI pipeline combining LLaMA 3 for structural analysis and NLLB-200 for neural machine translation across 200+ languages.
highlights: LLaMA 3 via Ollama for language detection & document structural analysis
NLLB-200 (HuggingFace) for neural translation across 200+ languages
Memory-safe sequential model execution — peak RAM under 4 GB on consumer hardware
Supports PDF, TXT, raw text; preserves formatting and outputs translated PDF

featured.title: AI Multi-Agent Platform
featured.subtitle: Professional Desktop Chat Application
featured.description: A professional multi-agent chat platform with persistent conversation history, context memory using sliding window, and specialized AI bots.
highlights: Multi-agent architecture: general chat bot + developer/coding assistant
Persistent SQLite conversation history with sliding window context memory
Interactive sidebar with live stats, session archive & full OOP structure
Custom CSS UI built with Streamlit for a polished professional look
